description: Node/dashboard toolchain setup. Pin Node 24 in .nvmrc, add engines field to dashboard/package.json, generate and commit package-lock.json for reproducible builds.
steps: Run 'npm install' in dashboard/ to generate package-lock.json (this will use npm from the Node 24 installation)
Verify package-lock.json was created and has lockfileVersion 3 or higher
Run 'npm run lint' in dashboard/ to verify linting passes
Run 'npm run build' in dashboard/ to verify build succeeds
Commit: git add .nvmrc dashboard/package.json dashboard/package-lock.json && git commit -m 'chore(dashboard): pin Node 24, add engines, commit package-lock.json'
acceptance_criteria: .nvmrc exists at repo root with content '24'
dashboard/package.json has engines field specifying node >= 24.0.0
npm run lint passes in dashboard/
npm run build succeeds in dashboard/
